title: How Many Pages Should Your Resume Be?
excerpt: If your resume is packed with AI slop, keep it to one page. Here's the honest answer to how long your resume should actually be.

blocks.text: Answering an Important Question: How Many Pages Should Your Resume Be?
To answer this question I need to make my tone a bit more direct:
If you're a student and you yourself know that you don't have a special resume and some AI Slop has just filled it with text for you, your resume should be at most 1 page.
If you have experience the story is different and up to 4 pages is allowed.

But the reality is that most of us, at most 2 pages of resume is enough for us to have. The reason is also that one person has to read that resume and the longer the resume is, the less likely it is to be read.
So try to make your resume at most 1 sheet which equals 2 pages. This is the best case.
But even up to 3 pages, it's fine :)
Don't write too much anymore, nobody reads it.
